**Finding: missing (TRANSITION) — redline proposed and submitted.**

- **Investigation:** Read §6 (Termination), §4 (Ownership/materials), §1, §5 and §7 (including the stray §6(c) at p0044 and the confidentiality clause at p0038–p0040). Keyword search returned no hits for data return/export/deletion/transition; the document has no defined "Customer Data".
- **Gap:** The only wind-down obligations are payment of accrued fees and assignment of Works in progress. There is no transition assistance, no data return/export, and no deletion obligation — failing both preferred and fallback.
- **Cure:** One insert as new §6(d) carrying exactly the six preferred elements: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, return of Company Data (defined inline to reach all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for us) in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion **after** that return. No survival tails, procedures, or other non-element boilerplate added; existing paragraphs untouched.
